Jo khud ko jeet leta hai, wo sabse bada yoddha hai.
Sher ki dahad tez hoti hai, lekin uska chup rehna daravna hota hai.
Khamoshi intezar hai.
Himmat ek dhimi aawaz hai.
Endurance stubborn nahi; purpose ke saath rukna hai.
Darr ke bawajood kaam karna himmat hai.
Fear ke bina courage rare hai.
Courage tab shuru hota hai jab hum aate hain aur apne aap ko dikhate hain.
Himmat aage le jati hai.
Jokhim uthana hi himmat hai.
Courage i resistance to fear, mastery of fear—na absence of fear.
Grit ye jaan'na hai ki tum sangharsh me akelay nahi ho.
Chup rehna sahmati dikhata hai.
Bahadur log hi sabse komal hote hain.
Himmat ek-doosre ko lag jaati hai.
Shuru karne ki himmat, chalane ki himmat.
Grit mehnat ko identity banata.
Himmat garmi hai.
Apni life ko apna message banao.
Khamoshi badi taqat ka source hai.
